title: SIDE BY SIDE
stanzas: Side by side we stand awaiting God's command worshipping the saving King. Living in His grace and moving on in faith Jesus Himself will see us through.
Soldiers all are we to go where Jesus leads, We'll fight in faith and we will overcome. Heaven is our goal, and saving every soul, pray that we all be there.
chorus: Meet in heaven, we'll join hands together, meet by the Savior's side, I'll meet you in heaven, we'll sing songs together, brothers and sisters, I'll be there.
